body: THE hard problem, and the one no prior art solves. The working extension only harvests Set-Cookie from main_frame navigations plus a hardcoded allowlist of one app's auth endpoints, because its own comments state that capturing from other sub-requests causes session churn that breaks CSRF. Find a capture policy that works on an UNKNOWN app: which responses to harvest from, and when to reset versus merge a cookie set. PASS: two sessions hold on an app the extension was never configured for, across login, navigate, refresh, reopen, with no CSRF errors.
title: S6 — generalized cookie capture without breaking CSRF
